info.title: Octavio Poultry Farm API Documentation
info.description: API contract and interactive documentation for the Octavio Poultry Farm management backend. Defines schemas, routes, parameters, and role-based permissions.

servers.description: API Base URL (relies on browser host or proxy)

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: User login, session retrieval, and profile security

tags.name: Batches
tags.description: Manage flock cycles, building-level chick loadings, and harvest production reports

tags.name: Inventory
tags.description: Register feeds, chicks, medicines, and record movements/adjustments

tags.name: Employees & Payroll
tags.description: Manage employees profiles, building assignments, and batch-wise payroll/reimbursements

tags.name: Daily Logs
tags.description: Record daily mortality, feed consumption, and bird weight logs by building

tags.name: Transactions & Ledger
tags.description: Post and void opex, capex, and revenue transactions, view ledger logs, and quick entry

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: User account provisioning, roles assignment, and system audit logs

tags.name: Settings & Data Exchange
tags.description: Import settings, export database records, and download historical archives

tags.name: Master Reference Data
tags.description: Fetch static categories, active buildings, and stakeholders list

tags.name: Public / AI Chat
tags.description: Public status summary and natural language operational assistance chatbot

post.description: Authenticates a user via email/username and password. On success, issues a secure HttpOnly token cookie and returns user profile metadata.

Set-Cookie.description: Contains JWT token; httpOnly; Secure (in prod); SameSite=Lax

post.summary: Log out and clear session cookie
post.description: Clears the HttpOnly 'token' cookie from the browser.

get.description: Returns details of the currently authenticated session.

post.description: Updates password for the currently logged-in user. Requires current password verification.

400.description: Missing inputs or new password too short

401.description: Current password is incorrect or session expired

get.description: Returns a list of all batch cycles recorded for the authenticated user's farm.

post.description: Registers a new flock cycle. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner. Validates and initializes defaults for building-level loadings.

get.description: Returns the single batch currently in 'Active' status for the user's farm, or 404 if no active batch is found.

patch.description: Modifies the details or status of a batch. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Batch not found or farm scoping violation

delete.description: Archives or deletes a batch. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Batch not found or farm scoping violation

get.summary: Get building loadings for a batch
get.description: Retrieves the loaded chick count and percentage distribution assigned to each building for a specific batch.

put.summary: Update building loadings for a batch
put.description: Overwrites building loading allocations. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Batch not found or farm scoping violation

get.summary: Get production metrics summary for a batch
get.description: Calculates cycle metrics including total feed consumed, total mortality count, survival rate percentage, total opex, capex, and revenues.

get.summary: Get harvest details and sales report
get.description: Retrieves the multi-harvest events, chicken sales, byproduct sales, and tolling financing adjustments for a completed flock cycle. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

put.description: Saves or updates the detailed harvest event sheets, byproduct listings, sales weight details, and financing entries. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

post.summary: Commit harvest metrics to the ledger
post.description: Aggregates harvest chicken sales and byproduct revenues, and automatically creates corresponding daily ledger transactions under a single transaction block. Voiding actions are tracked. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Retrieves active stock categories and catalog configurations. Supports filtering by optional item categories (e.g., 'Feed', 'Chicks', 'Medicine', 'Equipment').

post.description: Registers an item unit template. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

patch.summary: Update catalog settings for an item
patch.description: Modifies inventory properties, target quotas, unit definitions, and active toggles. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Item not found or farm scoping violation

get.description: Fetch real-time stock-in, usage, adjustments, and feed write-off history.

post.description: Creates an inventory flow ledger. If the payload indicates 'createLedger=true', automatically registers a matching opex/capex transaction on the cash ledger. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Retrieves profile settings, displays, phone, addresses, and hire histories. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

post.description: Registers a new employee stakeholder profile. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

patch.description: Updates profile configurations. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

delete.description: Sets active toggle status to false. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

get.summary: List batch compensation rates for all active employees
get.description: Retrieves bird counts, base rates, and assignments linked to a specific cycle. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

get.summary: List active assignments for a batch
get.description: Fetch list of employees, building placements, and bird shares for operations checking.

put.summary: Update compensation parameters for an employee
put.description: Saves bird shares, rate scales, and groups for payroll calculations. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Calculates complete paysheet for a cycle. Factors in: bird rates, building mortality counts, cash advances, and payroll reimbursements. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.
Retrieves daily operational reports (feed consumed, weights, mortalities). Supports filtering by batchId.

post.summary: Submit a new daily operational log
post.description: Registers daily mortality, weights, and feeds consumed. Generates automatic inventory write-downs. Requires role: DataEntry or above.

404.description: Batch or employee profile not found

patch.description: Modifies historical log variables. Recalculates and updates linked inventory stock movements. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Log not found or scoping violation

delete.description: Deletes log records and removes associated inventory changes. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Log not found or scoping violation

get.description: Retrieves transactions ledger records. Supports batch filtering.

post.summary: Post a new cash ledger transaction
post.description: Inserts cash ledger entry. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Retrieves all financial movements linked to a cycle. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

post.description: Inserts transaction entry scoped to a batch. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

patch.description: Edits description, metadata, or financial details. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Transaction not found or scoping violation

post.description: Flags a transaction as voided. Automatically voids linked inventory updates. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

404.description: Transaction not found or scoping violation

post.description: Flags a global ledger entry as void. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

delete.description: Proxies to voidTransaction to flag as inactive. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

get.summary: List audit logs for a batch
get.description: Retrieves the structural audit log of database creates, updates, and deletes for tracking. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

get.summary: Get audit logs for a specific transaction
get.description: Returns update logs for a transaction. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.
Retrieves summarized expenses by category. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.
Retrieves summarized capital investments by category. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.
Aggregates revenue and payments by customer. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.
Aggregates outstanding payroll and feed purchase balances. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

post.description: Parses unformatted multilingual text input (Visaya, Tagalog, English) into cash ledger schemas. Fallback parser activates if AI is disabled. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Returns complete login user registrations. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

post.description: Registers a new authentication record and connects it to a stakeholder. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

patch.description: Updates password hashes, roles, or toggles status. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

delete.description: Sets user active to false, logging them out. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Extracts global audit tracking. Requires role: PrimaryOwner.

post.description: Bulk inserts transaction and logging tables. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.

get.description: Retrieves bulk raw database rows in CSV format. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.
Retrieves zip export of complete historical cycles. Requires role: OperationManager or PrimaryOwner.
Returns active building references with loading sharing configs.
Returns active ledger item category tags.
Returns complete contact card listing (Employees, Buyers, Suppliers).

get.summary: Retrieve active batch without logging in
get.description: Returns active flock code, notes, and metrics for public visibility widgets.

post.summary: Submit operations questions to the assistant
post.description: Feeds question payload to the operations model context, automatically parsing and enforcing role boundaries (restricting financials for viewers).

reply.example: Yesterday, building A recorded 5 dead birds...

get.description: Simple keep-alive route.
